sloka: आनुपूर्व्यानिषेदुश्च सर्वे मन्त्रिपुरोहिता: ।तत: सेनापति: पश्चात् प्रशास्ता च निषेदतु: ॥ २.९१.३९॥
transliteration: ānupūrvyāniṣeduśca sarve mantripurohitā: ।tata: senāpati: paścāt praśāstā ca niṣedatu: ॥ 2.91.39॥

translations.english: He bowed in reverence and worshipped the throne (as though Rama were seated there). Taking hold of a fan made of yak's tail he sat in a minister's seat.
